protocol.purpose: oracle diagnosis only; not an inference pipeline
protocol.query_policy: same source detections and target candidate detections for each baseline/oracle pair
protocol.oracle_policy: global exact affine for translation/rigid/affine; per-query finite-difference Jacobian for heterogeneous fields; same Jacobian applied to all candidates for one query
protocol.target_resampling: Pillow bicubic intensity pullback and nearest-neighbour validity pullback

dedode_runtime_metadata.return_transfer: only sampled descriptors; dense maps are not exported
